sentences.en: The scores are low because the task is cognitively demanding.
sentences.zh: 由于这项任务在认知上要求很高，所以分数很低。

sentences.en: Bill is equal to the task of running the firm.
sentences.zh: 比尔完全能够胜任管理公司的重任。

sentences.en: The task is so difficult that I cannot accomplish it.
sentences.zh: 这个任务太难了，我无法完成。
